D'hak is a wolf in Crèche Y'llek in Act One.
“
If she keeps making me eat armour, I'm going on hunger strike.
„
— D'hak

Involvement

Act One

D'hak stands beside  Kith'rak Therezzyn in the Captain's Quarters, along with another wolf Ur'uth, feasting on the corpses of Mahrin and Burrock, ill-fated followers of the Cult of the Absolute.

D'hak can be spoken to using  Speak with Animals. The party can learn that both wolves are discontent with Therezzyn's habit of feeding them victims still in their armour.
